subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit policy notice remain open as the active contributor-facing announcement, or should it be closed now that the 20-PR policy is documented and shipped?
rationale: Current main and the latest release already implement the 20-cap policy, but the issue was later renamed, pinned, and reopened by a maintainer and carries explicit product/maintainer-review labels, so automation cannot safely infer the desired communication state.

options.title: Keep the pinned notice open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the active GitHub-facing contributor-policy announcement while `CONTRIBUTING.md` remains the source of truth for details.

options.title: Close as documented policy
options.body: Close the issue because the shipped contributor guide and automation now carry the policy, accepting that the pinned GitHub notice disappears.

options.title: Replace with docs pointer
options.body: Post a short maintainer comment pointing to `CONTRIBUTING.md` or public docs, then close or unpin according to maintainer preference.

recommendation.title: Keep the pinned notice open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the active GitHub-facing contributor-policy announcement while `CONTRIBUTING.md` remains the source of truth for details.

likelyOwner.reason: Takhoffman performed the rename, pin, and reopen actions that make this a communication-policy choice rather than a source implementation task.
